title: Opt-in fixed-point exponential for the first selected ceiling evaluation
body:
## Summary

- Opt-in fixed-point exponential for the first `ceiling()` evaluation of the selected complex local word. The pinned `research/complex-local-word-ceiling/ceiling.py` file is not edited; other packages still authenticate SHA-256 `86a1432870b3b21d8454106ec9162fddc0471472d9214c590a1420f2426cedfc`.
- On the published bracket `52814190909/31250000000000 < a < 1690054109089/1000000000000000`, all 672 exponential arguments visited by that search and by the one-extra-rank-1 search match the pinned Taylor series. A one-term truncation is rejected. Python 3.12 median after warm logarithms: 0.801 s to 0.017 s (46.58×). The verifier requires at least 5×.
- This is not the warm `child_cost` memoization in `research/exact-child-interval-reuse`, the degree-16 owner-check kernel in `research/exact-exp-performance`, or the domain extension in `research/ceiling-range-reduction`. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/ceiling-exp-fixed-point --check-only`
- [x] `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/ceiling-exp-fixed-point` prints `PASS_CEILING_EXP_FIXED_POINT`
- [ ] Universal equality for every rational in `[0, 1/2]` is not claimed. The pinned engine remains authoritative.

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3657

Seed `72c78c29f4a732aee66d631374cb276c`, card `replay-runtime`, scope refined. Base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. `scripts/research_baseline.py` could not bind the selected frontier in this checkout because the frontier1094 package roots are not materialized, so that full replay was not profiled.

Prepared by Riquelme Soares (@hevlyo), with substantial AI assistance. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
